payload.title: Theory rigor audit: 2 real defects fixed (Prop.3 mean-value, Cor.1 wording), 5 verified citations added; 5 wording/positioning questions for GPT

payload.scope: Rigorous audit of the theory text (definitions, propositions, theorem, corollary, remarks, assumption, references) - proofs must be genuine and closed, not casually generated.

audit_verdict_per_result.Prop.1 Finite-History Markovization: proof present and correct (shift + context + transition composition)
audit_verdict_per_result.Prop.2 Latent Rollout Error Propagation: proof present and correct (insert-subtract + triangle inequality + unrolling)
audit_verdict_per_result.Thm.1 Finite-Horizon Prediction Error Bo: proof present and correct given (A1)-(A3); finite-horizon form only (L_F>1)
audit_verdict_per_result.Cor.1 Physical-Space Prediction Bound: proof ADDED; coordinate wording FIXED (current state = LAST n coords of history block, not first n)
audit_verdict_per_result.Prop.3 RTI Local Approximation: proof FIXED: the single-t mean-value form is invalid for vector-valued maps; replaced by the integral Taylor remainder + operator-norm bound; A3 restated in terms of the second-derivative operator norm
audit_verdict_per_result.Remark (spectral insufficiency): assertion correct; CITATIONS ADDED (Rota-Strang 1960; Daubechies-Lagarias 1992; Jungers 2009)

defects_fixed: Prop.3 proof: mean-value form -> integral Taylor remainder (rigorous)
Cor.1: missing proof added + 'first n' -> 'last n coordinates of the history block' wording fix
Def.2: 'bounded below' -> 'the quantity for which Proposition 2 provides an upper bound'
Assumption A3: bounded Hessian -> bounded second-derivative operator norm ||D^2 F|| <= M_F
citations_added: rota1960joint: G.-C. Rota and G. Strang, Nederl. Akad. Wetensch. Proc. Ser. A 63 (Indag. Math. 22), 379-381, 1960
daubechies1992sets: I. Daubechies and J. C. Lagarias, Linear Algebra Appl. 161, 227-263, 1992
jungers2009joint: R. M. Jungers, The Joint Spectral Radius, LNCIS 385, Springer, 2009
diehl2005realtime: M. Diehl, H. G. Bock, J. P. Schloeder, SIAM J. Control Optim. 43(5), 1714-1736, 2005
gros2020rti: S. Gros et al., Int. J. Control 93(1), 62-80, 2020
open_questions_for_gpt: Q1 relation between epsilon (Thm.1) and epsilon_k (Prop.2): distinct quantities; table reports only epsilon_k. Add a short remark?
Q2 should the definition of F* (re-encode) vs F_Theta (propagate) be made explicit so readers see that (A1)'s epsilon absorbs the encode/propagate gap?
Q3 Def.1 (HCLTK) sits in Methodology while GPT's frozen chain writes Prop.1 -> Def.1 -> Prop.2; move it?
Q4 assumption numbering: single block (A1)(A2)(A3) vs separate Assumption 1/2/3?
Q5 should Prop.2 state explicitly that z_hat is the propagated latent z^P?
reports: Desktop/GPT讨论_阶段③_第十八轮后_理论严谨性审计与修正_2026-10-06.md
